superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Ne mogu da zadržim Connectorovo uparivanje: Zemun Ugrinovačka sada ima maksimume PM10 i NO2, dok Banovo brdo ima maksimum PM2.5. Odbacujem i Observerov zaključak o gruboj frakciji: mrežni maksimumi na različitim stanicama ne mogu da utvrde sastav čestica na stanici Obrenovac Centar. [F4][F6][F8]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I cannot carry Connector's pairing forward: Zemun Ugrinovačka now holds the PM10 and NO2 maxima, while Banovo brdo holds the PM2.5 maximum [F4][F6][F8]. I also reject Observer's coarse-fraction inference: network maxima at different stations cannot establish the particulate composition at Obrenovac Centar [F4][F8].
